content:
# Normalize text in the repository while preserving platform-specific scripts.
* text=auto eol=lf

*.sh              text eol=lf
*.bash            text eol=lf
*.zsh             text eol=lf
*.ps1             text eol=crlf
*.bat             text eol=crlf
*.cmd             text eol=crlf

# Common binary formats must never receive line-ending conversion.
*.png             binary
*.jpg             binary
*.jpeg            binary
*.gif             binary
*.webp            binary
*.ico             binary
*.pdf             binary
*.zip             binary
*.gz              binary
*.woff            binary
*.woff2           binary

# Improve generated and vendored diff behavior when these paths are introduced.
*.lock            -diff
vendor/**         linguist-vendored
generated/**      linguist-generated
machine/documents/** linguist-generated
machine/manifest.json linguist-generated
machine/graph.json linguist-generated
machine/corpus.jsonl linguist-generated

# EOS append-only event history.
# Git union prevents ordinary divergent append loss.
# EOS semantic validation remains authoritative.
.eos/events.jsonl merge=union
